evidence: Touches src/net.cpp, src/net_processing.cpp, and carries the P2P label, modifying BIP152 compact block announcement behavior.
rationale: Adds operator control over BIP152 high-bandwidth peer selection for low-latency or multi-site peering links. As described in the PR, operators running multi-location setups or low-latency peering links can ensure consistent compact block announcements instead of waiting for automatic three-peer rotation, which provides clear operational value but is reasonably deferrable.
